brief:
For four years running, conflict has prevented one Palestinian family from harvesting their olive crop, according to We Are Not Numbers. The disruption marks a prolonged interruption to a harvest cycle central to Palestinian agriculture and livelihoods across Gaza.

Olive cultivation is a mainstay of Palestinian farming economy, with the annual harvest traditionally providing income and sustenance to rural communities. The repeated loss of harvest seasons affects food production across Gaza during a period of sustained warfare.
dek: For four years in a row, war has prevented my family from harvesting our olives.
title: War blocks Palestinian family from harvesting olives for four consecutive years
